name: Akaunting
description: Core self-updater's HTTP client hardcodes verify=>false (SiteApi.php:18), disabling TLS validation for the endpoint serving the update zip, with no payload sig/hash. MITM-to-RCE on an accounting app. [Opus-verified: CONFIRMED-D]
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: The core self-update uses the shared Guzzle client with certificate validation disabled, downloads the core archive, and extracts it. No independent payload signature/hash check is present in this path.
limitations: Review is limited to the retained commit; it does not certify released artifacts or current upstream behavior.
